_about: Frozen definition of EV-023, the kensaku-v1-2 live sandbox acceptance (plan kensaku-v1-2). It runs locally only, never in CI. The agent-run steps use the owner's Stripe sandbox credentials and Stripe CLI login; the hosted-page steps are performed by the owner in a browser (D-049). Questions are reused verbatim from evals/cases/live-acceptance-v1-1.json.
preconditions: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in the ignored .env.local is a sandbox key (starts sk_test_, rk_test_, or rkcs_test_); the server refuses to start otherwise (REQ-023).
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env.local equals the secret printed by `stripe listen --print-secret` for the same sandbox.

`stripe listen --events checkout.session.completed,checkout.session.expired,checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded,checkout.session.async_payment_failed,payment_intent.payment_failed --forward-to http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/stripe/webhook` is running and logged in to the sandbox (not --live).
The server runs with `pnpm start` in live Exa mode on 127.0.0.1:8787, with an empty .data/commerce/ directory at the start of a run.
EXA_API_KEY is the free-plan key; the plan-wide Exa counter (.cache/live/v1-2-exa-counter.json, ignored) has room for the run's maximum.

queries.text: Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones: where can I buy them and are they worth it?
ソニー WH-1000XM5 はどこで買うのがいい？

scenarios.steps: Add the first addable USD merchant offer to the cart, quantity 1. Check out. On the Stripe-hosted page pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry, any CVC.
scenarios.expect: Order state paid set by a verified checkout.session.completed event; Kensaku shows 'Simulated payment received'; cart cleared; Stripe session amount_total equals the cart's demo total.

scenarios.steps: Add the first addable SGD offer. Check out. Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242 (or the Singapore card 4000 0070 2000 0003 if 4242 is refused for SGD).
scenarios.expect: paid via verified webhook; session currency sgd; amount_total equals demo total in cents.

scenarios.steps: Add the first addable JPY offer. Check out. Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242 (or the Japan card 4000 0039 2000 0003 if 4242 is refused for JPY).
scenarios.expect: paid via verified webhook; session currency jpy; amount_total equals the observed yen amount (zero-decimal).

scenarios.steps: Add a USD offer and check out. Enter the generic decline card 4000 0000 0000 0002. After the decline message, use the hosted page's back link to return to Kensaku.
scenarios.expect: Never paid; after return the order is cancelled and the cart is unchanged; Kensaku shows the decline note when declinedAttempts >= 1. Whether payment_intent.payment_failed arrives is recorded (R-30) but does not gate.

scenarios.steps: Add an SGD offer, check out, and on the hosted page use the back link without entering a card.
scenarios.expect: Order cancelled; the agent then retrieves the session through the API and finds status expired; cart unchanged.

scenarios.steps: Run `stripe events resend <id>` for A1's checkout.session.completed event id taken from the server's webhook log.
scenarios.expect: Server answers 200 duplicate; A1's order has exactly one paid transition; no other order changes.

scenarios.steps: Through the local API: put one registered offer in the cart, POST /api/checkout twice in a row.
scenarios.expect: The first order becomes expired (reason superseded) and a retrieve of its session through the API shows status expired; the second order is open. Then cancel the second order through POST /api/orders/:id/cancel: cancelled, session expired.

scenarios.steps: POST a checkout.session.completed body for A7's second order to http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/stripe/webhook without a Stripe-Signature header, then with a signature made with a different secret.
scenarios.expect: 400 both times; the order stays cancelled.

researchChecks: For each query, at least one offer in the market's currency is registered and addable (button enabled). If a query yields none, it may be re-asked once within the Exa budget; if it still yields none, the dependent scenario is BLOCKED, not FAIL, and the owner decides (revisit trigger), except A3 with Q5, which blockedAllowances decides (CR-006).
Research output still meets the v1.1 behaviour for these queries: no displayed comparison or reason contains a brace; main offer list only in the market currency.

thresholds.scenariosPassing: 8 of 8 (A1-A8), or 7 of 8 when the only scenario that does not pass is A3 and it is BLOCKED under blockedAllowances (CR-006). A3 BLOCKED for any other reason, or any other scenario not passing, does not meet this threshold.
thresholds.amountMismatches: 0 sessions whose amount_total or currency differs from the order.

ownerAudit: H1: On each Stripe-hosted page (A1-A5), every line item name starts with 'Simulated:' and the description says no order is placed with the merchant.
H2: On each hosted page the total equals the 'Demo total' Kensaku showed in the cart.
H3: In Kensaku, every cart line shows the 'Demo checkout price' separately from the 'Last observed' merchant price with host and time.
H4: Kensaku's cart, checkout return, and order list say 'Simulated' and never claim that a merchant order was placed.
H5: Declined (A4) and cancelled (A5) returns show a clear, non-alarming status and the cart is still there.
runLog: scripts/live-acceptance-v1-2.ts writes .futari/evidence/live/ev-023-run-<n>-<UTC timestamp>.json with: git SHA and dirty flag, Exa requests and cost per query and plan-wide, each scenario's order id, Stripe session id, event ids received with their outcomes, order state transitions, session retrieve results, each query's validated outcome summary (per product: market-currency offer ids and count, other-currency offer count, evidence items by category, rejected counts; no URLs or free text), and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED per scenario. Keys, webhook secrets, and full card numbers never appear in the log; the log never copies scenario instruction text or other free text from this file and refers to scenarios by id (CR-006). The owner's answers to H1-H5 go to .futari/evidence/live/ev-023-run-<n>-audit.md.
runRules: At most 2 runs. A run that fails a scenario because of a product defect is fixed and re-run within the Exa budget; a failure caused by a Stripe fact that differs from research (for example 127.0.0.1 redirect URLs refused, or SGD or JPY not presentable) stops execution for a plan revision. Run 1 ran on 2026-11-23 (log ev-023-run-1-20261123T125703Z.json); a tooling defect reduced its log to a summary, so its terminal output and server log are committed beside it as supplementary evidence; run 2 is the last permitted run (CR-006).

blockedAllowances.when: Q5 yields no JPY merchant offer after the permitted re-ask, judged from the evidence: the run log records, per query, each product's validated outcome summary from the stream (market-currency offer ids and count, other-currency offer count, evidence items by category, rejected counts), and the allowance applies only when Q5's summary contains no JPY merchant offer. A re-ask or first ask served from the 6-hour research cache counts; within that window run 2 re-serves run 1's Q5 results.
blockedAllowances.coverage: JPY handling stays covered by EV-018 (JPY minor-unit and cart cases), EV-019 (JPY session request R02), and the JM-203 live sandbox smoke, which created, retrieved and expired a real JPY session.
blockedAllowances.basis: CR-006, DECISIONS D-060: owner decision after EV-023 run 1 on 2026-11-23.
